newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: HP enters Singapore photography market.
newsitem.headline: HP enters Singapore photography market.

text.p: Computer giant Hewlett Packard (HP) has launched its PhotoSmart system in Singapore with hopes to change photography user technology, a marketing executive said on Friday.
"We expect PC photgraphy to change the way people take, enhance and develop their photos," Kevin Lai, a marketing manager for HP Far East Pte Ltd, said at a news conference.
The PhotoSmart system, which comprises a digital camera, a photo scanner and a photo printer, enables photo developing and manipulation using digital photography based on a standard PC.
The three products must be purchased separately and each comes with Microsoft's photo editing software, Picture it!.
The digital camera costs roughly Singapore $599 while the estimated prices of the other two products have not been determined, Lai said.
The system has already been launched in Hong Kong, Australia and United States.
The Photosmart system is available in the U.S for less than US$1,400 and the price in Singapore may be over S$2,000, Lai said. -- Singapore newsroom (870-3080)
